title: Waiting State for All UI Elements
description: Introduce a "waiting" UI state mirroring "loading": a dashed, slower-spinning, gentler-pulsing active-color border ring. Implement symmetrically in the React/Tailwind CSS renderer (ui/styling/js/ui.css, ui/js/react/index.tsx) and the wgpu/Rust renderer (ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs), then thread through the framework protocol layer (framework/core/js/index.ts, framework/renderer/react/index.tsx). Loading wins precedence when both flags are set. See approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/introduce-waiting-state-for-precious-pnueli.md.
summary:
Added a "waiting" UI state mirroring "loading": a dashed hairline ring that spins at half speed (3.2s vs 1.6s) with a gentler/shallower pulse (0.7–1.0 opacity vs 0.55–1.0), using identical active-color-when-active semantics. Implemented symmetrically across all three layers:

1. CSS/Tailwind (ui/styling/js/ui.css): --waiting-border-duration token, @property-registered --waiting-border-angle/-duration (required so Tailwind's prod pass doesn't prune the animation), waiting-border-spin/-pulse keyframes, and border-waiting / border-waiting-active / border-waiting-element utilities using a repeating-conic-gradient dash pattern (12 dashes, 60% duty) matched to the wgpu shader's dash constants.
2. React (ui/js/react/index.tsx): waitingBorderClass/-Active/-Element/waitingBorderStateClass helpers mirroring the loading ones; threaded waiting?: boolean through Action, Slider (track-wrap only), TreeDataItem/TreeDataSection, treeRowChromeContentFillClasses/treeRowChromeClasses, TreeRow/TreeItem, WindowMeasureTreeRow/Leaf, and Window. Precedence: loading wins when both flags are set (loadingBorderStateClass(...) || waitingBorderStateClass(...) idiom everywhere, aria-busy ORs both). Added 12 mirrored/precedence vitest tests, all passing.
3. wgpu/WGSL (ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs): waiting: Option<bool> added to UiStackNode, UiButtonNode, UiSectionNode, UiTreeItemNode (+ ::base), UiTreeSectionNode, UiTreeNode, and the WindowMeasure::Slider enum variant, mirroring every loading field 1:1 (including the composite-tree conversion functions). KIND_WAITING_BORDER=7.0, UiInstance::waiting_border, DrawList::push_waiting_border, paint_waiting_border, a new WGSL kind==7 shader branch (dash gate via step(fract(...)) instead of the comet sweep, duration=3.2, pulse 0.85−0.15·cos), and if-loading-else-if-waiting dispatch at every paint site (Stack, Section, Button, Tree, TreeItem). Added 6 new Rust tests — all passing under `cargo test --features engine,typegen waiting`.
4. Protocol layer: framework/core/js/index.ts gained waiting?: boolean beside loading?: boolean on the six UI node types; framework/renderer/react/index.tsx threads it through the control-button, tree-item, tree-section, and measure-slider conversions. Regenerated framework/core/js/generated/manifest.ts via ts-rs typegen (also incidentally fixed a stale-manifest bug causing unrelated typecheck failures).

Verification: `cargo check --features engine,typegen --all-targets` on ui_wgpu passes clean; all new Rust tests (6/6) and vitest tests (12/12 targeted) pass; `bunx nx run @semio-tech/ui-react:typecheck` passes with zero errors. `cargo clippy` could not run to completion because it also compiles kernel_3d_scene (a dependency), which has 3 pre-existing unrelated clippy::map_unwrap_or errors — flagged separately as its own follow-up task, out of scope here. Bug found and fixed during verification: waiting was added to construction sites for UiTreeSectionNode/UiTreeNode before the field existed on those two struct definitions — caught by cargo check, fixed immediately. Also recovered this ticket's ticket.json after it was deleted by unrelated concurrent repo activity mid-session (restored verbatim from git history).
